evidence.title: GitHub - dmitrykurash/holocloth: Real-time holographic cloth design tool.

name: Holocloth
summary: Browser tool for draping images on a holographic cloth simulation, then exporting the result as PNG.
description: A sheet of simulated cloth floating in space: grab it, throw it around, drape your own images or SVGs over it as fabric or stickers, and watch them ripple like printed on holo foil. Iridescent foil, chrome and black cloth materials, macro depth of field, film grain and bloom, with one-click PNG export with or without background.
contains: real cloth physics written from scratch (Verlet integration, no physics library)
iridescent foil shader with rainbow diffraction, sparkle and bump maps
upload any image or SVG as the cloth or as a sticker on top of it
macro depth of field with click-to-focus, ambient occlusion, film grain, bloom
one-click PNG export, with or without the background
save looks and switch between versions while working
built with Three.js (WebGL 2), React, TypeScript, Vite and DialKit
